Organization.title: Organization
Organization.subtitle: Administer your organization — the account above your workspaces. These settings apply to every workspace in the organization.
Organization.noAccessBody: You need an organization owner or admin role to manage these settings.

OrgOverview.identityDescription: Manage the display name shared by every workspace in this organization.
OrgOverview.nameHint: This name updates throughout the organization and workspace shell.
OrgOverview.slugHint: This stable identifier cannot be changed here.
OrgOverview.stale: The organization changed while you were editing. Refresh and try again.
OrgOverview.layoutDescription: See how organization authority, workspaces, and the memberships you may access fit together.
OrgOverview.lifecycleDescription: Export complete workspace holdings or permanently remove tenant data. These actions require passkey re-authentication.
OrgOverview.rosterRestricted: You may see this workspace in the organization, but its membership stays private until you belong to it.
OrgOverview.workspacesEmpty: This organization has no active workspaces.
OrgOverview.loadFailed: Could not load the organization layout.
OrgOverview.loadMoreFailed: Could not load more of the organization layout.
OrgOverview.loadFailedBody: The organization structure could not be loaded. Your permissions and membership data have not been inferred.
OrgOverview.switchInProgress: Another workspace operation is already in progress.
OrgOverview.navigationFailed: Could not open that workspace or member.

OrgDataLifecycle.ownerAuthority: You are an organization owner. You can export workspaces and permanently tear down workspaces or this organization.
OrgDataLifecycle.adminAuthority: You are an organization administrator. You can export workspaces; only an organization owner can tear them down.
OrgDataLifecycle.plaintextDescription: The ZIP can contain personal data and managed files without encryption. Download it only to approved storage, then encrypt and restrict access according to your retention procedure.
OrgDataLifecycle.noWorkspaces: There are no active workspaces available to export or remove.
OrgDataLifecycle.exportFailed: The workspace export could not be started.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationTeardownDescription: This removes every workspace, membership, configuration, tenant record, and managed file in the organization.
OrgDataLifecycle.ownerOnlyDescription: Workspace ownership is separate from organization authority. Ask an organization owner to complete a workspace or organization teardown.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmWorkspaceDescription: A passkey prompt will verify you before Connex starts the permanent workspace teardown.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmOrganizationDescription: A passkey prompt will verify you before Connex permanently tears down the organization and every workspace in it.
OrgDataLifecycle.workspaceRetention: Workspace records and managed files are deleted. Integrity-protected audit metadata and closed or refused organization-level data-subject request records are retained with workspace and person links cleared. Backup copies expire under the backup-retention policy.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationRetention: All organization workspaces, memberships, settings, tenant records, managed files, and closed or refused data-subject request records are deleted. Integrity-protected audit metadata is retained without the deleted organization link. Backup copies expire under the backup-retention policy.
OrgDataLifecycle.confirmationHint: The confirmation is case-sensitive. Spaces are not removed.
OrgDataLifecycle.workspaceOpenObligation: This workspace still has an open data-subject request. Close or refuse that obligation, then try the teardown again.
OrgDataLifecycle.organizationOpenObligation: This organization still has an open data-subject request. Close or refuse every obligation, then try the teardown again.
OrgDataLifecycle.teardownFailed: Connex refused the teardown because its safety checks did not complete.

OrgAi.title: AI provider
OrgAi.subtitle: Bring your own AI provider for this organization. Connex masks text identifiers where feasible and audits every outbound request. Image features, including fallback business-card reading, send metadata-free image data whose visible contents cannot be masked. AI stays off until you configure and enable a provider here.
OrgAi.workspaceEnableDescription: This workspace kill switch overrides member AI permissions and stops in-flight assistant turns at the next safety check.
OrgAi.assistantMaxStepsDescription: Limit each Ask Connex turn to 1-12 model or tool steps.
OrgAi.governanceSaveFailed: Could not save the workspace AI controls.
OrgAi.dailyBudgetDescription: A shared UTC-day limit enforced in the database across every Connex server and workspace in this organization.
OrgAi.dailyTokenLimitHint: Set 0 for unlimited. In-flight calls reserve a conservative ceiling before provider egress.
OrgAi.budgetSaveFailed: Could not save the organization AI budget.
OrgAi.enableDescription: Let members who hold the AI permission use AI features in this organization's workspaces.
OrgAi.bedrockModelIdHint: A Bedrock Claude model or inference-profile ID, e.g. anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0.
OrgAi.azureEndpointHint: Your Azure OpenAI resource URL, e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com.
OrgAi.vertexRegionHint: A Vertex AI location, e.g. asia-northeast1 or us-central1.
OrgAi.serviceAccountJsonHint: Paste the JSON key file of a service account with Vertex AI access. Stored encrypted; never shown.
OrgAi.genericEndpointHint: An HTTPS endpoint implementing the OpenAI chat completions API, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.
OrgAi.allowInternalDescription: Permit a private-network address over HTTP(S). Available only when the instance operator allows private AI endpoints.
OrgAi.attestLabel: Our provider agreement disallows training and long-term retention on submitted data
OrgAi.attestDescription: Confirm that your contract with the selected provider excludes model training and long-term retention of submitted Connex text and images. Required before AI can be enabled.
OrgAi.credentialKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored credential. Stored encrypted; never shown.
OrgAi.saveFailed: Could not save the AI provider settings.
OrgAi.stepUpRequired: Recent sign-in required. Verify your identity in Settings → Security, then try again.
OrgAi.loadFailed: Could not load the AI provider settings.

OrgMembers.title: Administrators
OrgMembers.subtitle: People who can administer this organization — configure SSO, allowed domains, and manage administrators. Distinct from workspace membership.
OrgMembers.roleOwnerHint: Full control, including managing administrators and ownership.
OrgMembers.roleAdminHint: Administer org settings, but not administrators.
OrgMembers.removeConfirmBody: {name} will lose organization administrator access. Their workspace membership is unaffected.
OrgMembers.lastOwnerTooltip: An organization must keep at least one owner. Promote another owner first.
OrgMembers.addSubtitle: Grant an existing Connex account organization access by email. Owners can manage administrators; admins can configure settings.

OrgDomains.title: Allowed domains
OrgDomains.subtitle: Restrict who can be invited into any workspace in this organization. When set, every invite and join — links, email invites, and SSO — must match one of these email domains. Leave empty to allow any domain.
OrgDomains.label: Email domain
OrgDomains.empty: No domain restrictions — members can be invited from any email domain. Add a domain to restrict who can join workspaces in this organization.
OrgDomains.loadError: Couldn't load allowed domains. Refresh to try again.

OrgAudit.title: Audit log
OrgAudit.subtitle: Organization-level governance events — SSO configuration, administrators, and allowed-domain changes. Workspace record changes appear in each workspace's own audit log.

OrgDataRequests.title: Data-subject requests
OrgDataRequests.subtitle: Track disclosure, correction, and cease-of-use requests under the APPI, and assemble disclosure exports for verified requests.
OrgDataRequests.empty: No data-subject requests yet. Log one when a request arrives; disclosure exports need a linked contact and recorded identity verification.
OrgDataRequests.loadError: Requests could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
OrgDataRequests.disclosureDownloaded: Disclosure export downloaded. Apply statutory redactions before sharing it with the subject.
OrgDataRequests.disclosureFailed: The disclosure could not be assembled.
OrgDataRequests.createDescription: Record who is asking, which right they invoke, and when it arrived.
OrgDataRequests.editDescription: Update the lifecycle as verification, response, and closure happen.
OrgDataRequests.subjectLinkHint: Optional, but required before a disclosure export can be assembled.
OrgDataRequests.fieldIdentityVerifiedHint: Disclosure exports refuse to assemble until this is recorded.
OrgDataRequests.toastSaveFailed: The request could not be saved.
